Story:
After months of veterinary visits, surgeries, and follow-up appointments, Ben has finally been cleared to find the loving home he deserves!
Like many French Bulldogs, Ben came to us with severe chronic ear disease. His ears were beyond repair, and he underwent a TECA (Total Ear Canal Ablation) surgery to relieve the constant pain and infection he had been living with. Thanks to his amazing veterinary team, he’s feeling so much better.
Ben doesn’t hear very well anymore—if at all—but that certainly doesn’t stop him from enjoying life! In true Frenchie fashion, he still loves to sing the song of his people and will happily let you know when he has something important to say.
Ben is ready to leave all those vet appointments behind and trade them for cozy beds, belly rubs, and a family to call his own. He’s a sweet, resilient boy who has overcome so much, and now it’s his turn to be spoiled.
